ja: テサロニケ人への手紙第一 3

p.src: 1  Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

ja: えられなくなった私たちは、自分たちだけでアテネに
en: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,
u.src: 1  Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

p.src: 2  and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

ja: わしました。あなたがたの
en: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,
u.src: 2  and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

zh: 3:2 作上帝執事的：有古卷是與上帝同工的

p.src: 3  that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

ja: それは、だれもこれらの
することがないためです。私たちがこのために定められていることは、あなたがた
en: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.
u.src: 3  that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

p.src: 4  For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

ja: 、あなたがたと一緒にいたとき、
もって話していました。そして、そのとおりになったことを、あなたがたは
en: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.
u.src: 4  For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

p.src: 5  For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

ja: えられなくなり、あなたがたの
になってはいないかと
en: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.
u.src: 5  For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

p.src: 6  But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

ja: 、テモテがあなたがたのもとから
たちのところへ帰って来て、あなたがたの
えてくれました。また、あなたがたがいつも
たちを温かく心に留め、
望していることも知らせてくれました。
en: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.
u.src: 6  But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

p.src: 7  For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

ja: たちはあらゆる苦悩と
にあっても、あなたがたの
en: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.
u.src: 7  For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

p.src: 8  For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

en: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.
u.src: 8  For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

p.src: 9  For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

ja: たちは、あなたがたのことで、神に感謝してもしきれません。あなたがたのゆえに、
en: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,
u.src: 9  For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

p.src: 10  night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

ja: うことができるようにと、夜も昼も切に祈っています。
en: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
u.src: 10  night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

p.src: 11  Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

ja: イエス・キリストが、あなたがたのもとへ行く道を開いてくださいますように。
en: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
u.src: 11  Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

p.src: 12  May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

ja: しているように、主が、互いに対する愛とすべての人に対する愛を、あなたがたのうちに
え、あふれさせてくださいますように。
en: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,
u.src: 12  May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

p.src: 13  to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

ja: さのうちに非難されるところのないものとしてくださいますように。
en: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
